```

```

n8n is a pnpm workspace, so that resolves the dependency and updates the single root `pnpm-lock.yaml` in one step. Running it from inside the package directory works too; `--filter` from the root is the more common n8n idiom. Nothing else needs hand-editing — don't touch the lockfile directly.
